baseline.equivalence_test: existing entity_pair, global_context, and soft_role_pair configurations replay their pre-successor outputs on fixed inputs

core_invariants: keep data loading, labels, metrics, and the Re-TACRED evaluation protocol outside the plugin
action routing reads query, key, and padding masks only; subject/object masks are not used to construct the anchor
centered score residuals remain query-aligned and have zero key-sum on active rows
existing relation anchor modes retain their prior configuration and checkpoint semantics
quantum and matched classical kernels share the same successor anchor and parameter budget

interfaces.output_schema: relation_anchor[batch,heads,4*head_dim] for legacy modes or [batch,heads,query_tokens,4*head_dim] for query-conditioned mode
invariants: query-conditioned anchor is aligned to the query token axis

plugins.insertion_point: relation anchor construction before score-kernel feature encoding
plugins.hypothesis: query-conditioned source/target soft role distributions can reverse role emphasis with the query while preserving label-free attention steering
plugins.output_schema: per-query source/target role context concatenated as source,target,source-target,source*target
plugins.resource_estimate: two learned role direction banks per head; O(batch*heads*query_tokens*key_tokens*2) routing logits; no additional quantum qubits
failure_signatures: role weights are query-invariant on the declared reversal fixture
padding tokens receive nonzero routing mass
residual is non-finite or violates centered zero-sum invariant
matched classical control is not parameter-count matched
formal single-seed valid/test gain is below +0.001 versus disabled baseline or below -0.0005 versus matched classical control

plugins.hypothesis: the legacy key-only soft-role pair remains the null successor comparator

plugins.insertion_point: same relation anchor insertion point with matched classical score kernel
plugins.hypothesis: any task utility from query-conditioned routing may be explained by the matched classical kernel
plugins.resource_estimate: same role-router parameter count and tensor shapes as quantum control
failure_signatures: parameter count or checkpoint schema differs from quantum control

composition.merge_rule: evaluate one anchor mode at a time; no implicit composition with expert routing

validation.baseline_equivalence: legacy modes exactly replay fixed-fixture outputs and checkpoint round-trips
tests: query-conditioned role weights change when query changes
padding tokens receive zero role mass
centered residual has zero key-sum and finite values
quantum and classical successor controls have matched trainable parameter counts
formal run remains gated until the complete-data single-seed protocol is explicitly authorized

reproducibility.environment: Python >=3.10 and torch >=2.0; CPU unit/smoke tests

limitations: the current implementation is mechanism-only and does not establish natural-task utility
the matched classical router is expected to reproduce the same role-routing mechanism; no quantum advantage is implied
the plan does not itself authorize a formal Re-TACRED run; any such run remains a separate user-authorized single-seed gate
expert-router composition is not part of the successor screen and must be separately specified if needed
